protocol.target: full three-state filtered belief from tokens and executed actions, recomputed with eps02 emissions; no rewards
protocol.checkpoints: actual saved zero-step initialization and final; c4b uses original parent zero-step init, not the restored 2B join
protocol.streams: split(fold_in(PRNGKey(training_seed),2)); archive-compatible independent fit/test streams, reused across checkpoints within seed
protocol.representation: 64D post-final-LayerNorm; head-blind null of two own-head logit-difference rows (62D); common shift retained
protocol.within_class: class-specific affine refits; 1-sum(class SSE)/sum(class test-mean-centered SST); per-class values retained
protocol.between_class_fraction: 1-within-class test SST/global test SST: descriptive class-mean oracle; separate class_only_held_out fits class means on fit rows
protocol.matched_init: init encoder replayed on exact final-policy complete token/previous-action streams including warmup; final beliefs/classes/row order fixed
protocol.controls: one fixed perturbation per split, original targets/classes retained; shuffle nonreset token/action pairs within each episode; random input from empirical reset/nonreset pair pools; labels permuted within fit class; probes refit
protocol.bootstrap: 10000 whole-training-seed resamples, equal weight per seed; paired final-minus-matched values resampled together; no timestep pooling across seeds
protocol.eligibility: exclude finals with fewer than two observed fit/test classes or excluded full-h predictions from within-class claims; all_seed_descriptive retains them explicitly
protocol.archive_rule: Historical discrepancy threshold max(0.01, 5 * CPU episode-bootstrap SE), now annotations only by user authorization. No archived-parity hard stops. Primary matched comparisons use verified checkpoints and identical CPU histories.
caveats: affine accessibility does not establish causal use or Bayesian computation
one-class within-class scores are global accessibility, not conditional evidence
CIs quantify training-seed variability conditional on fixed replay/probe streams and fit data
controls are fixed-draw descriptive distribution shifts, not significance tests
matching histories controls visitation but not causality; own-policy init is secondary
continuation restarts Adam moments; secondary comparison has one training seed

provenance.import_method: git archive of eps02 Ladder studies' Python sources, AGENTS and three required JSON records per run; no merge/rebase; reward_factors and unrelated main changes excluded
provenance.collector_equivalence: main differs only by epsilon-mixture training sampling/likelihood support; greedy raw-logit argmax, key splitting and belief filtering are unchanged; default probe temperature1/epsilon0 identical
